description: Envelope v1 worked example (crypto design doc §4.1). Randomness is the counter 0x00, 0x01, ... drawn in order: DEK (32), payload nonce (24), then one wrap nonce (24) per audience.
payload_note: CBOR {"pv": 1, "title": "Football training"}; the envelope treats it as opaque bytes
independent_check: python3 test-vectors/verify_envelope.py <envelope> <gck> decrypts this with a from-scratch implementation that shares no code with the Rust crate.
